entities.summary: Alexander Wedderburn, 1st Earl of Rosslyn, PC, KC was a British lawyer and politician who sat in the House of Commons of Great Britain between 1761 and 1780 when he was raised to the peerage as Baron Loughborough. He served as Lord Chancellor from 1793 to 1801.
